title_zh: 请室友帮忙移走窗边蜘蛛

scenario.label_zh: 请室友帮忙移走窗边蜘蛛
scenario.goal_zh: 辨认窗边蜘蛛并商定不直接用手接触的移走办法

context_zh: 室友发现窗边的小蜘蛛，向同伴请求帮助把它移走。
author: author-phase04-c

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: There's a strange shadow moving beside the window. Could you have a look?

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: It's a small spider on the curtain.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: I'm not keen on getting close to it. Can you help me move it?

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: Sure. Bring me that clear container and a piece of card. I won't need to pick it up with my fingers.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: Here you go. I'll open the outside door for you.
